name: MonarchDevicePicker
title: DevicePicker
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox through MonarchSelect, with MonarchInlineNotice; device data from android.media.AudioManager and android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager supplied by the app
summary: Microphone, camera and audio output menus for a call's lobby or settings, with a notice that explains camera and microphone access and a way to fix it.
whenToUse: In a pre-join lobby or a call's settings sheet, so people can choose which microphone, camera and audio output the call uses.
whenNotToUse: To show the camera preview use the app's CameraX or call SDK view beside it. For a generic choice from a list use MonarchSelect.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDevicePicker(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, microphone: String? = null, onMicrophoneChange: ((String?) -> Unit)? = null, camera: String? = null, onCameraChange: ((String?) -> Unit)? = null, speaker: String? = null, onSpeakerChange: ((String?) -> Unit)? = null, microphones: List<MonarchDevicePickerDevice> = emptyList(), cameras: List<MonarchDevicePickerDevice> = emptyList(), speakers: List<MonarchDevicePickerDevice> = emptyList(), access: MonarchDevicePickerAccess = MonarchDevicePickerAccess.Granted, size: MonarchDevicePickerSize = MonarchDevicePickerSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchDevicePickerLabels = MonarchDevicePickerLabels(), onRequestAccess: (() -> Unit)? = null, onOpenSettings: (() -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchDevicePickerAccess { Granted, NotDetermined, Denied, Unavailable }

class MonarchDevicePickerLabels(microphone: String? = null, camera: String? = null, speaker: String? = null, systemDefault: String? = null, unnamedMicrophone: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null, unnamedCamera: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null, unnamedSpeaker: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null, notDetermined: String? = null, allowAccess: String? = null, denied: String? = null, openSettings: String? = null, unavailable: String? = null)

options.name: microphone
options.description: The chosen microphone's id; null is "System default".

options.name: onMicrophoneChange
options.description: Shows the microphone field; called with the new id, null for System default.

options.name: camera
options.description: The chosen camera's id; null is "System default".

options.name: onCameraChange
options.description: Shows the camera field; called with the new id, null for System default.

options.name: speaker
options.description: The chosen audio output's id; null is "System default".

options.name: onSpeakerChange
options.description: Shows the audio output field; called with the new id, null for System default.

options.name: microphones
options.description: The microphones offered, usually AudioManager.getDevices(GET_DEVICES_INPUTS) mapped by the app.

options.name: cameras
options.description: The cameras offered, usually CameraManager.cameraIdList named by lens facing.

options.name: speakers
options.description: The audio outputs offered, usually AudioManager.availableCommunicationDevices (API 31) mapped by the app.

options.name: access
options.description: The camera and microphone permission state to explain, as the app knows it.

options.name: size
options.description: Md for a lobby or settings screen; Sm has tighter spacing and a small notice button, for a sheet during a call.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the fields and the notice's button can be used.

options.name: onRequestAccess
options.description: Shows Allow access while access is not asked; the app requests the permissions, usually with rememberLauncherForActivityResult(RequestMultiplePermissions()).

options.name: onOpenSettings
options.description: Replaces what Open Settings does when access is refused. null opens the app's page in the system Settings (Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS).

states.name: not asked
states.description: An info notice "Allow camera and microphone access to choose devices." with Allow access when onRequestAccess is set; the microphone and camera fields are disabled.

states.name: denied
states.description: A warning notice that access is off, with Open Settings; the microphone and camera fields are disabled.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: A neutral notice "No camera or microphone was found.", also shown when access is granted but no shown microphone or camera field has a device.

states.name: removed device
states.description: A selected id that is no longer listed stays selected, numbered after the listed devices: "Microphone 3".

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled false every field and the notice's button are disabled.

appearance: MonarchSelect fields with the outline, label and text colors of MonarchTextField, and MonarchInlineNotice in the info, warning or neutral tone. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: The web lists devices with navigator.mediaDevices and selects outputs with setSinkId; on Android the app lists inputs and outputs with AudioManager and cameras with CameraManager, applies the choice itself (AudioManager.setCommunicationDevice from API 31, the camera id it opens) and passes new lists when devices change (AudioDeviceCallback). Unlike iOS, which must use the system route picker, Android has its own audio output menu. Monarch declares no permissions and does not read or request them: access is a parameter and the request is onRequestAccess, because only the app's activity can launch the permission request and know whether Android still shows it (Denied is the state after the request is no longer shown). Device names are always known on Android, so the web's "names hidden" state becomes the not-asked state. The picker does not show a camera preview (no CameraX dependency); put the app's preview beside it.
accessibility: Each field is MonarchSelect: a read-only Material 3 field named by its label (Microphone, Camera, Speaker) with the current choice as its text, which opens a menu whose chosen option is read as selected.
The notice is MonarchInlineNotice, a polite live region read as its tone and message; its action is a separate MonarchButton with a 48dp touch target.
Fields that cannot be used without access are disabled, so TalkBack reads them as disabled.
States are text, never color alone.
edgeCases: Devices with an empty id are left out, and a repeated id is listed once; an empty selection is System default.
Devices with a blank name are numbered by their position: "Camera 2".
With access granted and no microphone or camera to list, the unavailable notice explains the empty menus.
Open Settings without onOpenSettings starts the app's details page in Settings; on a device without it nothing happens.
The menus, notices and buttons were checked with Robolectric tests, not on a device with TalkBack; the permission request and the Settings page are the app's and were not run.

examples.title: Before access is allowed
examples.template:
MonarchDevicePicker(
    microphone = microphone,
    onMicrophoneChange = { microphone = it },
    camera = camera,
    onCameraChange = { camera = it },
    speaker = speaker,
    onSpeakerChange = { speaker = it },
    microphones = listOf(
        MonarchDevicePickerDevice({{microphones.0.id}}, {{microphones.0.label}}),
        MonarchDevicePickerDevice({{microphones.1.id}}, {{microphones.1.label}}),
    ),
    cameras = listOf(MonarchDevicePickerDevice({{cameras.0.id}}, {{cameras.0.label}})),
    speakers = listOf(MonarchDevicePickerDevice({{speakers.0.id}}, {{speakers.0.label}})),
    access = MonarchDevicePickerAccess.NotDetermined,
    onRequestAccess = {},
)
examples.code:
MonarchDevicePicker(
    microphone = microphone,
    onMicrophoneChange = { microphone = it },
    camera = camera,
    onCameraChange = { camera = it },
    speaker = speaker,
    onSpeakerChange = { speaker = it },
    microphones = listOf(
        MonarchDevicePickerDevice("a", ""),
        MonarchDevicePickerDevice("b", ""),
    ),
    cameras = listOf(MonarchDevicePickerDevice("c", "")),
    speakers = listOf(MonarchDevicePickerDevice("d", "")),
    access = MonarchDevicePickerAccess.NotDetermined,
    onRequestAccess = {},
)

examples.title: Before access is asked, small
examples.code:
MonarchDevicePicker(
    onMicrophoneChange = {},
    onCameraChange = {},
    access = if (asked) MonarchDevicePickerAccess.Granted else MonarchDevicePickerAccess.NotDetermined,
    size = MonarchDevicePickerSize.Sm,
    onRequestAccess = { asked = true },
)
